summary: Allot Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq and the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, furnished a Form 6-K attaching its press release announcing third-quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. Revenue rose 16% year-over-year to $30.6 million, SECaaS revenue reached $9.9 million (up 37%), and September 2026 SECaaS ARR was $38.8 million, up 41%. GAAP operating income was $2.8 million and operating cash flow $7.4 million. The filing is a routine earnings release, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. Watch for recurring-revenue conversion and cash generation.
